notes.title: Wakey Wakey: Wildest Dreams Update - Coming this fall!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059915/4df65fdb53ef729ec56fb6658bf82f13a66cd907.png"][/img][/p][p]Coming this Fall, Wakey Wakey is going to launch its Wildest Dreams Update! notes.title: v1.0.4 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi Wakey Wakey Enjoyers!

v1.0.4 is just going to be a quick hotfix solving an issue that some users are encountering where after completing a level, the game locks up only showing a black screen.

Thank you to everyone who reached out and informed us of this issue!

- Moon Jam Games

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.3
notes.content:
Another installment of Wakey Wakey Patch Notes is here!

With this small update we fixed some lingering audio and visual bugs.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed paddle ball being able to clip through walls in Level 34
[*] Block completion colors in Level 36 have been updated
[*] Fixed bug where the demon cry audio would be cut off if multiple demons were in the bedroom
[*] Gave the sleepy kid and pushable blocks movement audio in the dream and nightmare versions of “Let’s Take a Break” (Level 29).
[*] Added movement audio and particles for the pushable blocks in the dream and nightmare version of “Time For an Adventure” (Level 27).
[*] Fixed bug where pushable blocks would not make movement sounds while on the ceiling.
[*] Fixed bug that cause various input glyphs to occasionally disappear when switching input devices.
[*] Removed landing particles from both the dream and nightmare versions of “Dad’s Favorite Level” (Level 40)
[*] Added back in skin particle trails to both the dream and nightmare versions of “Straight Ballin’”(Level 34)
[/list]

Thank you so much to everyone who has helped us locate these bugs by contacting us through the discord and the bug report form.

- Moon Jam Games

notes.title: Soundtrack, Steam Deck, & Bug Fixes... Oh my!
notes.content:
Hey Wakey Wakey Enjoyers! We've got an exciting update for you!

First up, the [b]Wakey Wakey Official OST is now available on Steam![/b]
Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568970/Wakey_Wakey_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568970/Wakey_Wakey_Soundtrack/[/url]
A special shout out to our composer Xavier Chapman, who created all of the lovely music you hear in the game.


Next up, some updates to the base Wakey Wakey game including more refined Steam Deck support & some major & minor bug fixes. Here are the patch notes:

[b]Steam Deck Support:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Wakey Wakey intro gameplay videos would be skipped entirely or appear as a debug screen on Steam Deck.
[*] Adjusted the controls tab on the menus to show a Steam Deck control scheme instead of a controller when playing on a Steam Deck.
[*] Steam deck is now fully supported on our end. “Yipee” - a programmer
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed additional Misspellings in credits.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed “Grimm, Weaver of a Thousand Nightmares” to bounce on trampolines (Sorry Grimm).
[*] Changed Fullscreen toggle to be a borderless Fullscreen window instead of an exclusive Fullscreen window.
[*] Added click sounds to options screen togglable options.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed players to push the Sisyphus block in both Dream and Nightmare Levels 25 without scaling.
[*] Fixed bug where fuzzies would teleport in Dream Level 33.
[*] Fixed stretched tile backgrounds in levels with pits.
[*] Fixed collisions in Nightmare Level 7.
[*] Falling in the pit in Nightmare Level 35 will now fail the level.
[*] Fixed collision of upside-down trampoline in Nightmare Level 44.
[*] When in gauntlet mode, the in-game timer will now display overall gauntlet time rather than the current level time.
[*] Fixed bug where the profile screen would show the incorrect world 3 teddy color
[*] Game window can now run in the background.
[*] Fixed bug that made credits appear and reappear in unintended areas.
[*] Fixed bug where controller users could tab to another world when not on the world select screen.
[*] Fixed bug where the player would be unable to go to the main menu screen after attempting to use the back button while spamming the world tab hotkey.
[*] Fixed bug where costume trails would appear in front of the wallpaper of Dream and Nightmare Levels 34.
[/list]

Finally we want to give a huge thank you to all of you for an amazing first month after launch! Thanks to you we have sold over 300 copies of Wakey Wakey across a dozen different countries. We are so honored and humbled by the reception the game has received. Thank you so much.

- Moon Jam Games

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.1
notes.content:
The first installment of Wakey Wakey Patch Notes is here!

With this update we intend to fix some issues regarding leaderboard times and address easy to fix visual bugs.

As some of you may have noticed, there are some top scoring leaderboard times that seem impossible to replicate. Thanks to the help of our playtesting community, we have found this is due to an unintended bug that will randomly let you start a level early on restart. We have solved this issue, and to ensure leaderboard integrity and promote competition for top spots, we will be adjusting top leaderboard times back 0.75 seconds. With this change, high speed players will still keep their top spot on the leaderboard, but have their times reduced back to what is possible without using the exploit.

Along with that, we have made some fixes to small visual bugs and grammatical typos.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an input bug allowing players to move while level transition was playing. 
[*] To ensure the integrity of the leaderboards times below a certain threshold will be adjusted to approximate their non-exploited value.
[*] Fixed an error that caused the millisecond position on leaderboard times to be displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed an error that caused the golf ball hit sound to decrease in pitch instead of volume
[*] Fixed an error that prevented the counter for the "Captive Prisoner" achievement from incrementing when completing a level with the ending leaderboard enabled
[*] Fixed a misspelled name in the credits
[*] Added a system to assist with tracking and logging errors 
[*] Fixed an incorrect color on music note asset in world three
[*] Fixed an error preventing the “Ultimate Champion” achievement from being achieved
[*] Fixed an incorrect tile in level 32 Nightmare
[*] Capitalized C in corruption in level 44
[*] Fixed orange fuzzys text in level 41
[*] Fixed fuzzy particle layering in level 39
[*] Can no longer crouch in level 23 Nightmare
[*] Demon layering issue fixed in level 21 Nightmare
[*] Fixed save files other than the one selected displaying incorrect teddy completion
[/list]

Thank you to everyone that has helped point out issues on our discord and used the bug report option in the main menu. We plan to release more updates in the coming weeks with more fixes that we have discovered.

- Moon Jam Games

notes.title: Wakey Wakey is Now Available!
notes.content:
Wakey Wakey is now available for purchase on Steam!

Going from a simple 48 hour game jam, to a fully fledged indie game on Steam, is a dream come true. A huge thank you to everyone behind the scenes who helped make this possible! From playtesters & professors to friends & family. It's with your support that we we're able to make this dream a reality. 

Thank you so much, we hope you enjoy!

- Moon Jam Games
